items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the piano player’s piano teacher had a group of students, and she wanted to hold a little reception for her students, of which my friend Roger was one of her students... So he came to us. He said, my piano teacher, she wants us to play... In fact we played basically together until we got into colleg

ctx.x: Who came up with the name?

I think the piano player did. I think. I was talking to somebody about that today. The first job – well, I don’t know if I’d call it a job. I would say, where some money was paid to a group of us – the piano player’s piano teacher had a group of students, and she wanted to hold a little reception for her students, of which my friend Roger was one of her students.
